sections.title: Inputs And Safety
sections.text: Read-only snapshot of one native sketch. Supply schemaVersion:1, sketch, and explicit expectations selecting real SketchPoint/SketchCurve refs discovered from sketch.inspect. Each expectation asserts point, center, start, end, radius, or diameter; coordinates are unit-bearing expressions. frame is sketch(default), model, or world. Root-world checks for non-root sketches require an explicit occurrence. Optional featureBRep checks explicit BRep entity membership in a named feature's output bodies; it does not infer profile provenance. No solve, recompute, mutation, repair, restore action, or inferred occurrence is performed.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns schemaVersion, operation, success/status, separate healthStatus and geometryStatus, analytic entity checks, optional featureBRep checks, documentIdentity, sketch ref, explicit frames/units, and snapshot associativity. Each point reports sketch/model/world, native worldGeometry, and model-to-sketch roundtrip comparisons. Unavailable requested properties remain unknown. Coordinate checks report precision:analytic; this certifies only requested numerical readbacks within tolerance, not the entire sketch or feature history.

examples.label: Check a discovered circular curve
examples.requires: Section is a native root-component sketch, the token is a current curve ref from sketch.inspect, and the expected values were independently measured. Placeholder tokens are not real entity IDs.
examples.output: A healthy sketch with a shifted center or incorrect diameter reports healthStatus:pass and geometryStatus:fail; it does not alter the sketch.

verified: Explicit sketch/model/world coordinate and roundtrip comparisons
Requested native worldGeometry and explicit feature BRep readback
Health and geometry outcomes remain separate

sections.title: Inputs And Selection
sections.text: Read-only query for one native sketch. Optional query criteria are conjunctive: index, area, centroid, contains, outerLoops, and innerLoops. Area and areaTolerance are positive finite numbers in cm². Optional expected counts cover profiles, loops, outerLoops, and innerLoops. Area and centroid are native high-accuracy integral readbacks; containment/topology use bounded evaluator strokes and the existing curve graph. Containment includes holes; tolerance-band points are unknown. The query never selects profiles.item(0): no match, ambiguous matches, missing topology, or unresolved candidates return no usable profile selector.

sections.title: Evidence And Limits
sections.text: Returns separate healthStatus, geometryStatus, analytic native integral/topology evidence, and sampled topology/containment evidence. A passing sampled query has evidenceStatus:partial and precision:sampled. Branches, degeneracies, duplicate strokes, open loops and intersections fail sampled topology. Native area accuracy is SDK-controlled; strokes are not an exact continuous certificate and do not certify G1/G2, manufacturability, or physical correctness. No mutation or geometry repair occurs.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns profiles/counts/candidate checks and selection diagnostics. The top-level profile selector is present only when all requested evidence, whole-sketch sampled topology and native profile topology/integrals pass, with exactly one complete candidate. Counts with missing topology remain unknown rather than zero. Coordinate and length tolerances are explicit length expressions; area and area tolerance are numeric cm² values.

examples.label: Find a profile with one hole
examples.requires: Section is an existing sketch; compare the integral expectation against an independently calculated reference. The sample is documentation, not a discovered profile or live Fusion result.
examples.output: The query returns one selector only if native topology/integrals and bounded sampled checks are complete and the profile matches uniquely.

verified: Native area/centroid and outer/inner loop enumeration
Hole-aware sampled containment and unique profile selection
Reuse of existing curve loop graph without a second solver
